messages:
incident-bot: Paging @jamie (oncall): High error rate detected on embeddings->reranker batch endpoint (batch/v1/score). 5xx spike, ~30% of requests failing in last 3m. Incident severity: P2. https://monitoring/redwood/alerts/12345 :rotating_light:
jamie (oncall): I'm on it, looking at traces now. Can someone post service errors or recent deploys?
jamie (oncall): Quick note: affected endpoint is the reranker batch path used by search and personalization jobs.
sabrina (eng): I pushed a tiny fix to the batch serializer last night but only to staging. No prod deploys from me today.
eva (ml): I'm joining. If it's embeddings->reranker sizing mismatch, could be quantization or vector length. Which model variant is behind the reranker?
jamie (oncall): Model id: rwr-bert-v2-1024 (production). Metric: error 502s with "incompatible vector length" logged.
tom (se): Customer reports: search rankings unreliable and 5xx for some queries. luis, can you confirm which customers are affected?
luis (prod): Three enterprise accounts reported errors and a spike in latency. Our gateway shows 502 and 500 responses for /search/score when reranker returns error. I'm flagging support tickets.
ryan (sre): Pulling logs from the batch-realtime cluster.
ryan (sre): Logs snippet:
```
2026-03-15T14:02:12Z batch-worker-17 ERROR reranker.handler: Unexpected vector length=1536 expected=1024 request_id=aa3f4c
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/srv/reranker/handler.py", line 122, in score_batch
    scores = model.score(vectors)
  File "/srv/models/rwr_wrapper.py", line 87, in score
    raise ValueError(f"incompatible vector length={vectors.shape[1]} expected={self.dim}")
ValueError: incompatible vector length=1536 expected=1024
```
ryan (sre): Also seeing a cascade: downstream request to scoring service returns 500 -> api gateway returns 502.
jamie (oncall): Initial hypothesis: embedding producer produced 1536-d vectors (maybe a new embedder variant) while reranker expects 1024. Could be a config drift between batch-embedder and reranker.
eva (ml): That makes sense. We recently onboarded a quantized embedder model that outputs 1536. It should have been routed to a different reranker variant. Hypothesis: routing table or manifest mislabelled model dims.
sabrina (eng): Checking gitops: deployment manifests for batch-embedder were updated yesterday to point to embedder:v3-1536. The reranker service config pins to 1024-variant. But the batch pipeline uses a transformation step that selects reranker based on model metadata. I see a recent PR that loosened vector-length validation to allow flexible shapes for A/B.
jamie (oncall): Can we mitigate live? Options: 1) Block the batch endpoint that feeds the pipeline (quick kill) 2) Enable runtime validation and reject mismatched vectors with 400 instead of 500 3) Roll back embedder to v2-1024 (if safe) 4) Route traffic to a compatible reranker variant.
ryan (sre): I'm going to temporarily block batch/v1/score from the public LB and return 429 for in-flight jobs to reduce customer impact. Executing policy change now.
ryan (sre): Done. LB rule applied -> traffic for batch scoring reduced by 95%. Error rate on downstream services subsided.
luis (prod): Support: letting affected customers know we're mitigating; no full data loss but degraded search. I'll send canned update.
eva (ml): While traffic is blocked, we can validate model manifests and update router to pick reranker-1536 variant. I can prepare the manifest change.
sabrina (eng): I'll prepare a quick patch to re-enable strict vector validation in the pipeline code, so future mismatches fail fast and don't cascade. Drafting patch now.
tom (se): We should also add a canary check: at ingest time, assert vector length == expected and log with request_id.
jamie (oncall): Handing over to sabrina for post-mitigation verification. I'm going to rotate out at +30m. @sabrina you'll be on-call lead.
sabrina (eng): Acknowledged. Taking lead. Steps: (1) Confirm embedder manifest -> rolling back embedder to v2-1024 or re-route (2) Deploy validation patch to pipeline (3) Run smoke tests with synthetic requests (4) Reopen LB when safe.
eva (ml): Quick check: model registry shows embedder:v3-1536 was promoted yesterday via automation. I'll revert promotion in registry to v2-1024 and update routing table to map v3 to reranker-1536.
sabrina (eng): Patch ready. Validation code (snippet):
```
# pipeline/validate.py
if vectors.shape[1] != expected_dim:
    raise BadRequest("vector length mismatch")
```
sabrina (eng): Deploying patch to staging first, then prod canary.
ryan (sre): Reversion of registry done by eva. Registry now maps prod->v2-1024. I will keep LB block in place until we verify.
jamie (oncall): ETA for full reopen?
sabrina (eng): If smoke passes in ~10m, we can slowly reopen LB. Planning a phased re-enable (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with metric gates.
luis (prod): I'll coordinate customer comms and note that mitigation is in flight.
tom (se): For the RCA doc we'll need timeline, root cause hypothesis, config diffs, and a list of remediation actions. Can we collect the PR that loosened validation? I’ll add it to the thread.
sabrina (eng): PR: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/582 (validation change) - reverting.
eva (ml): Also PR promoting embedder: github.com/redwood/model-registry/pull/314 (auto-promotion).
ryan (sre): Metrics look good after LB block. Error rate back to baseline.
sabrina (eng): Running canary now at 10% with old embedder mapping -> smoke OK. Releasing 50%.
luis (prod): Customers updated: support ticket IDs #10123 #10124 #10125.
jamie (oncall): I'm signing off on rotation. Sabrina will continue as lead. Any further escalations ping @sabrina.
sabrina (eng): Reopen LB to 100% stepped. Observing metrics.
sabrina (eng): All green for 5m. Restoring full traffic.
eva (ml): Postmortem tasks I propose: (1) Add manifest schema enforcement so model dim is explicit and blocked on promotion. (2) Add router verification tests. (3) Improve monitoring to alert on vector-length mismatch (not just 5xx rate).
tom (se): I'll own the E2E smoke test and add a pre-promotion check in CI.
ryan (sre): I'll leave LB rule in audit and add a runbook section for blocking batch endpoints.
luis (prod): I'll prepare customer follow-up with RCA summary.
sabrina (eng): Creating RCA draft notes now, will include timeline and logs. Assigning follow-ups: "manifest schema" -> eva, "validation in pipeline" -> sabrina, "CI smoke" -> tom, "runbook" -> ryan, "customer comms" -> luis.
sabrina (eng): Draft link: https://docs/internal/incidents/1778003456-embedder-routing-reranker-rca (will populate)
jamie (oncall): Thanks team. Good mitigation. I'm marking on-call handoff complete. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Alert resolved (incident cleared) at 2026-03-15T14:12:02Z.
